show.description: Raj Mehra had it all — power, money, pride — until his ego destroyed everything. Nine years ago, he drove away his wife, Shanaya, with a divorce she never wanted. Now she’s back as the fierce CEO of Sitara, the rival empire threatening his family’s legacy. But Shanaya holds a deeper secret — a daughter he never knew existed. As love, guilt, and revenge collide, old wounds ignite into a war where hearts and empires will burn.
